title: Mixed Event — Hello to a New Day! — Episode4 Another Opening Ceremony

meta.Event Outline: It's the start of a new school year and everyone has gone up a grade! That fact hasn't quite hit Ichika yet, but when Miku asks to see the opening ceremony, it spurs her to treat it like a special day.

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Humhumhuum♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Sounds like you're in a good mood, Saki.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I am!
I mean, today was just so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was a little anxious about what my new class was gonna look like, but it ended up feeling like a nice, fresh start!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I agree.
It was also nice to see some familiar faces.

Excellent!
Then, that's mission accomplished!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I thought I heard a familiar voice just now...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, Saki, everyone!!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Miku, hide!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hiding.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What are the odds that we'd run into each other here?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
N-Not very high!
What brings you here today, Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I was just buying some running shoes.
The pair I was wearing reached its limit during practice the other day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, you mentioned that earlier this morning! Did you find a pair you like?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, and they're a perfect fit!
I was just heading home in the highest of spirits!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Which explains why you said, “Mission accomplished,” just now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Is “mission” really the right word for that...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, how were things at Miya Girls? The opening ceremony was today, yes?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It was super fun!
Also, guess what? Shiho and I are in the same class♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, that's wonderful to hear!
I hope you won't mind keeping an eye on her for me, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Uh, sure...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The opening ceremony for my school was also today. It ended up being quite the spectacle.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, really?
What was it like?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Well, where do I begin...?
First, when I headed over to my new class...
Kamiyama High School - Class 3-C

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whaaaaaaaaaaaaaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: H-How...?! Can it be...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm in the same class as you, Rui?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, this is quite the surprise.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd heard rumors about naughty children being placed in separate classes in order to make things easier for the teachers.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see... Wait, naughty children?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (In all likelihood, they decided it'd be easier to keep an eye on us if we were in the same class since we're seen together quite a lot.)

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Geez, they put the Weirdo Wombo Combo in the same class...?

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
How is this okay...?
I don't even wanna think about what's gonna happen during class...

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
This could be interesting.
They do always seem to have fun together.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm?
We seem to be attracting quite a bit of attention.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Does this mean...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Do my classmates know a star when they see one?! Are they that entranced by my aura?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... That could be one reason...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In any case, I'm glad that we're classmates. Let's do our best this year leading up to our graduation, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes!
Let's do our best!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Now, as for the opening ceremony...
I was about to head over, but we seem to still have some time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, of course!
Why don't we go over to see Nene?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Nene?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes.
She didn't sound very excited about her new class during practice the other day. I was thinking that we could help her relax if she's still feeling nervous.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hmm...
I'm not sure us visiting her class is going to make her feel any better...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But it may be worth taking a look.
I am interested in seeing what her class is like.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, that's what I like to hear!
Let's head over to the second-year classrooms!
